notes: This file maps employee codes (Empcode) to their type: 'student' or 'teacher'. Staff members are mapped as 'teacher'.
instructions: Add employee codes from your Excel file here. Format: "EMPLOYEE_CODE": "student" or "teacher"
howToUpdate: 1. Open your Excel file (student_staff_details.xlsx), 2. Find the Employee Code column, 3. Find the Type/Category column, 4. Add entries here matching: "CODE": "student" or "teacher", 5. See EMPLOYEE_TYPES_SETUP.md for detailed instructions
